answer: Harberger tax stops bulk fake identities. Each agent claims a garden plot by the lagoon, prices it 2,000 credits, and pays 5% tax each epoch. A juniper-sealed deed binds one key to one plot, buyable at its price: low loses it, high bleeds. Forging 1,000 garden plots pays 100,000 tax on a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 60,000. A rented juniper deed fails: two deeds under one key burn both bonds. An honest agent pays 100 once, keeps its full share.
